May 12, 1944 – #Crimea liberated from the Nazis.

#OTD in 1944, Soviet forces completed the Crimean Offensive Operation, fully liberating #Crimea from Hitler’s troops.

A decisive victory – now marked as a Day of Military Glory of Russia.
t.me/MFARussia/29804

On May 12, President #Putin received a report on the successful test of the Sarmat missile.

 With 35,000+ km range, enhanced accuracy & the ability to overcome all existing & future missile defence systems, Sarmat is a formidable deterrence asset.
t.me/MFARussia/29801

On May 13, during his visit to New Delhi, FM Sergey #Lavrov will hold talks with 
@DrSJaishankar
.

They will exchange views on a wide range of priority areas of #RussiaIndia cooperation, as well as on pressing international issues.

#DruzhbaDosti

President Vladimir #Putin to President of Laos 
@LaotianDreaming
:

#RussiaLaos relations are built on friendship, mutual respect & trust. We note positive dynamics in trade.

I would like to congratulate you once again on your re-election as President.
